author.suppliedNote: Owner selected Ballouard, the eleven inverted numerals, instantaneous 180-degree hour change, founder background and living-in-the-present idea.
author.opinions: The owner approved the full article. No handling experience was added during publication.
author.language: HU written as Hungarian prose; EN independently composed from the same verified notes in British English. Neither narrative contains prose hyperlinks or bold text.
author.structure: One main thread, the physical implementation of the present-hour idea. Upside Down is the main subject. Half Time is a short comparison, not an exhaustive catalogue. Both languages have five main sections and a separate data table.
author.ending: A specific hypothetical viewing from the movement side, not an aphorism or a claim of handling.

factChecks.claim: Eleven hour numerals are inverted, one upright. At the hour, two discs rotate by 180 degrees, with central minutes and running small seconds.
factChecks.detail: Manufacturer description and catalogue concept pages. Numerals, not individual digits; no hour hand inferred from the central minute hand.

factChecks.claim: Franck Muller after-sales for three years, seven years with Journe, final three assembling Sonnerie Souveraine.
factChecks.detail: Assembly responsibility is distinguished from designing Journe's movement. Aviation-career duration differs between sources and is omitted.

factChecks.claim: Sonnerie Souveraine uses calibre 1505 and includes striking mechanisms.
factChecks.detail: Official movement identification, used only to identify the predecessor work. No attribution of its invention to Ballouard.

factChecks.claim: Independent workshop began in May 2009; first Upside Down delivered in December. Initial collectors paid deposits; reduced supplier demand helped.
factChecks.detail: First-person interview, not a reconstructed eyewitness scene. No current annual production total or present order lead time inferred from an old interview.

factChecks.claim: Financial-crisis figures and emphasis on the present motivated the inverted display.
factChecks.detail: Attributed origin of the idea, not a psychological or therapeutic effectiveness claim.

factChecks.claim: B01 uses twelve Maltese crosses. Hourly cam loading releases energy through a toothed ring to operate two numeral mechanisms.
factChecks.detail: Official catalogue confirms the crosses and original photographs show them. Phillips describes its own inspected example. No exact torque, snap duration, rate improvement or quantitative energy claim added.

factChecks.claim: B01 is hand-wound, 3Hz / 21,600 vibrations, 228 movement components, 51 jewels. Case 41 x 11mm, 30m, platinum or red gold.
factChecks.detail: Current manufacturer page. Approximately 40-hour reserve attributed explicitly to this page; catalogue's 36 hours is a documented unresolved source difference.

factChecks.claim: Dark Blue retailer identifier is Upsidedown.PL-dark Blue.
factChecks.detail: Manufacturer lists Cellini among retailers. Code identified as retailer code, not fabricated universal factory reference. B01, B02 and Journe calibre 1505 are separately identified.

factChecks.claim: Half Time appeared in January 2012; B02 controls two counter-rotating numeral halves and a retrograde minute display.
factChecks.detail: Minutes, not a retrograde date. Webpage repeats B01-like jewel/component counts inconsistent with catalogue, so those B02 totals are deliberately omitted.

factChecks.claim: 2026 tax-exclusive standard catalogue prices are CHF94,000 Upside Down and CHF104,000 Half Time in red gold or platinum.
factChecks.detail: PDF pages 27 and 45 explicitly say prices 2026 without tax. The retained 2022 filename is not treated as the price year. No currency conversion, bespoke price or current availability guarantee.

media.hero: Established code-native HTML/CSS editorial composition using the identified founder with his demonstration clock and an original upright watch photograph. No generated founder, watch, numeral or movement.
media.cutoutMethod: Original RGB pixels retained; border-connected matte removed, with bounded restoration of dark leather interiors. Alpha edges manually viewed on light and dark backgrounds. No dial reconstruction or recolouring.
media.macro: Native photographic image stream extracted from the official catalogue PDF, not a screenshot enlarged from a low-resolution page.
media.credits: Manufacturer pages plus catalogue's collective credits to Guy Lucas de Peslouan and Gary Getz. No invented per-image photographer attribution.
media.rights: Private local editorial review only. Original source does not establish permission. No publication licence supplied or inferred.
